user.title: GI Flex
user.description: Interpret unfamiliar light commands with DeepSeek. Known Home Assistant commands can still run locally.

init.title: GI Flex speech
init.description: When enabled, speech after the wake word is sent once to OpenAI (up to 20 seconds per turn) unless the local recognizer returns an exact light command: on/off, brightness percent, or a bare light name. This includes other requests, clarification replies, other voices and background speech after a false wake. The speech component keeps no recordings; Home Assistant history still stores transcripts. Turn this off or select original GI to stop uploads. Leave the key blank to keep the saved key; turning this off does not delete it.

data.cloud_speech_enabled: Send non-exact speech to OpenAI for transcription
